entities.summary: Peru-Bolivia Confederation, a political institution in Bolivia during Independence, Caudillos, and the War of the Pacific (1830–1880). Grew from Bolivia declares independence — August 6, 1825 and Independence War and the Republic of Bolívar. Led to the emergence of Caudillo Era and the Peru-Bolivia Confederation and Bolivia permanently loses Pacific coast access — Treaty of Valparaíso 1884.
